args.title: Bellwether Office: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Combined Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the latest Bellwether Office newsletter ("Warehouse automation in 2026"), its linked article (https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/warehouse), and the article's companion piece (https://insights.bellwether.example/warehouse/companion):

• Pick rates rose 18% in 2026 warehouse automation deployments using autonomous carts.
• Integration took twice as long as planned, signaling implementation timelines are a key risk factor.
• The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks, per the companion piece.
